design_doc_maturity_note: UPDATED 2026-09-22, FINAL (was: 'connection-pooling-design.md remains first-draft (v1), not yet independently reviewed' -- stale after a dedicated 2-round adversarial solution-architect review of that doc specifically). Both Sprint 5 design docs now have real, dedicated review history. dpdp-crypto-shredding-full-erasure-design.md is v2.2, having been through 13 solution-architect rounds AND a separate 4-round consensus-agent failure-mode/retry/rollback/escalation review, both ending in a clean APPROVE for DASH-STORY-027 with no outstanding findings. connection-pooling-design.md is now v2.2, having been through its own dedicated 2-round adversarial solution-architect review (round 1 found a real defect -- the doc's claimed migration mechanism didn't match how src/dashanan/api/composition.py and app.py actually construct repositories today, and Zone 8's manifest/consolidation/archiver/erasure-service classes were entirely missing from scope; round 2 verified the fix and found 2 further issues -- a scrambled zone-number/repository-name pairing and an understated DASH-STORY-028 story-point estimate -- both fixed) plus a follow-on consensus-agent failure-mode review that found DASH-STORY-028's expanded scope lacked a disclosed rollback path and clear retry granularity -- both fixed, bumping to v2.2. Neither doc is marked IMPLEMENTATION-READY in its own Status line yet (that requires also clearing a real dispatched Phase C gate, which has not run for either), but both have now had genuine adversarial review depth, not a single authoring pass. This sprint plan and the Phase 7 routing bundle that follows it are therefore honestly scoped as PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-READY planning, not yet a Phase-C-gate-hardened bundle ready for Phase B dispatch -- see sprint5-ar5-rs-computation.md's Verdict for the explicit gating consequence of this.

dependency_graph.note: Both stories are in one build-order group -- they touch disjoint files (DASH-STORY-027: subject-index table, zone8_crypto_shredding call sites, compliance-role adapters, DELETE/export endpoints; DASH-STORY-028: composition_root.py's connection-acquisition boundary only) and neither depends on the other, so they can be planned, reviewed, and (in a future Phase B) dispatched in parallel. DASH-STORY-027 depends on the already-shipped DASH-STORY-020, which is not a Sprint 5 story.

risk_flags.risk: The design doc surfaced a new prerequisite finding during this planning pass: Zones 4/5 have no Shape B (Postgres) storage today, so DASH-STORY-027's own cascade cannot reach them. Story scope was narrowed to Zones 1/2/3/6/7/8 with a forward-compatible interface, and a new backlog stub (FR-011-ZONE-4-5-SHAPE-B) records the prerequisite rather than silently shrinking AC-013's own SRS text to match. AC-013 will not be FULLY closed by DASH-STORY-027 alone until that prerequisite also ships.

OAQ-10 (does crypto-shredding legally satisfy DPDP Act 2023 erasure) remains unresolved and is not something an engineering story can close -- it requires real legal review, disclosed as out of this story's own reach in every artifact this bundle produces.
